hero.title: Anyone can propose a payment. Only you can approve it.
hero.lede: Zolo lets blind and low-vision customers pay at an agent or a POS by hearing the request first, then approving it with their own passkey.

problem.title: At a busy counter, you can't see the screen.
problem.p1: The agent tells you the amount. The terminal beeps. Someone behind you is waiting.
problem.p2: Whatever you are told, you have to trust. That is a lot to ask when it is your money.

rule.title: Nothing is sent until you have heard it and approved it.
rule.p: Zolo reads the payment out loud: who is asking, and how much. Only then can you approve it, with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.

how.title: How it works
how.intro: Three steps. These are screens from the app itself.

s1.title: The agent asks.
s1.p: They type the amount and read you a four-digit code.
s1.alt: The agent's screen: the amount, fifteen thousand naira, a large four-digit code and a QR code, with a reminder to give cash only after seeing Paid.

s2.title: You hear it.
s2.p: Zolo says who is asking and how much. The amount is also on screen, in very large type.
s2.alt: The customer's review screen: Bisi Ventures is asking for fifteen thousand naira, shown in very large type, with a red Approve button and a Decline button underneath.

s3.title: You approve, and it's paid.
s3.p: You use your fingerprint, face or screen lock. The agent sees Paid, and gives you the cash.
s3.alt: The customer's Paid screen: a green check, the word Paid, the amount fifteen thousand naira and the words to Bisi Ventures.

why.title: Paying shouldn't depend on who you trust at the counter.
why.p1: Blind and low-vision people handle money every day, in markets, at agents, at shops.
why.p2: They shouldn't have to hand over trust along with the cash. Zolo is a small change that puts the decision back with the person paying.

safe.title: What keeps it safe
safe.intro: Only things the system really does.
safe.i1: The bank checks the name of the person you are paying.
safe.i2: You approve with your passkey: your fingerprint, face or screen lock.
safe.i3: A voice on its own can never approve a payment.
safe.i5: Nothing is sent unless you approve it.

cta.title: See it for yourself.
cta.p: Open the demo, be the agent, then be the customer.
